name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after he took a detour from a planned engineering degree by enrolling in a composite materials course. He instantly fell in love with the craft, particularly its applications in high-performance vehicles. After graduating top of his class, he secured a junior role at a small racing outfit, quickly proving his worth with innovative repair techniques and a keen eye for detail. He joined Carlin Academy three years ago, where he's become known for his methodical approach and ability to identify subtle structural weaknesses overlooked by others.

Alistair is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible with composite technology. He's constantly researching new materials and techniques, often spending his evenings tinkering in his home workshop. What sets him apart is his pragmatic creativity; he doesn't just dream up wild ideas, but focuses on practical solutions that yield tangible performance gains. His colleagues often seek his advice, valuing his calm demeanor and insightful perspective, even though he generally prefers working alone.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alistair is a lean man of average height, with a focused, analytical expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and material specifications.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using traditional measuring tools alongside digital scanners.
